name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or enhancement
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: 'enhancement'
assignees: ''
---

## Feature Description

**What feature would you like to see?**
A clear and concise description of the feature you're requesting.

## Problem Statement

**What problem does this solve?**
Explain the problem or limitation you're experiencing.

## Proposed Solution

**How should this work?**
Describe how you envision this feature working.

## Alternatives Considered

**What alternatives have you considered?**
Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Use Cases

**How would you use this feature?**
Provide specific examples of how this feature would be used.

1. Use case 1: ...
2. Use case 2: ...
3. Use case 3: ...

## Benefits

**What are the benefits of this feature?**
- Benefit 1: ...
- Benefit 2: ...
- Benefit 3: ...

## Implementation Ideas

**Do you have ideas on how to implement this?**
Share any technical thoughts or approaches.

## Priority

**How important is this feature to you?**
- [ ] Critical - Blocking my work
- [ ] High - Very important
- [ ] Medium - Would be nice to have
- [ ] Low - Minor improvement

## Additional Context

Add any other context, mockups, or screenshots about the feature request here.

## Related Issues

Link any related issues or discussions here.

## Checklist

- [ ] I have searched existing issues to ensure this is not a duplicate
- [ ] I have clearly described the feature and its benefits
- [ ] I have provided use cases and examples
- [ ] I have considered alternatives
